calibration.provenance: Synthetic witness map, not measured. Centre 0.5 nm/s chosen to match WashU's general typical rate only.

coordinateFrame: sample-local x/y mm, origin centre; positive orientation rotates x toward y in calibration plane
method: bilinear rate interpolation; midpoint angular averaging; thickness = rate × open-shutter duration
coverageMeaning: fraction of sampled planar grid points meeting threshold; not step coverage
stressReason: No material-specific measured stress relationship supplied.
